 Addl.

 Justice S.K. Sahoo
 Order
Order No. 18.08.2023
 04.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in connection with Khaparakhol P.S. Case No.129 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. Case No.701 of 2021 pending before the learned S.D.J.M., Patnagarh for commission of alleged offences under sections 420/467/468/471/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the earlier anticipatory bail application of the petitioner in ABLAPL No. 12674 of 2021 was disposed of as withdrawn on 29.10.2021 and in the meantime // 2 // some of the co-accused persons have been granted anticipatory bail.
He files the copy of the bail order of one of the co-accused, which is taken on record.

When the matter was taken up on 04.08.2023, as per order dated 28.07.2023, learned counsel for the State has produced the written instruction dated 03.08.2023 received from the B.E.O.,

sentences.text:
Since the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is ready and willing to deposit such amount in the learned Court below, direction was given to the petitioner to deposit such amount in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Patnagarh in G.R.
Case No. 701 of 2021 and to produce documentary proof in that respect.

Today, learned counsel for the petitioner has produced the certified copy of the order dated 09.08.2023 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Patnagarh with a memo, which indicates that there has been deposit of Rs.1,39,860/- (rupees one lakh thirty nine thousand eight hundred sixty) as per the order of this Court.
The certified copy filed by the learned counsel for the petitioner is taken on record.
Perused the F.I.R. annexed to the anticipatory // 3 // bail application.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, since the offences are triable by Magistrate, co-accused has been released on bail and the petitioner has deposited the amount in question, I am inclined to release the petitioner on anticipatory bail and accordingly, this Court directs that in the event of arrest of the petitioner in connection with the aforesaid case, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (rupees ten thousand) with two sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer with further conditions that he shall make himself available for interrogation by the I.O. as and when required and he shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing any facts to the Courts or to the Investigating Officer.
Violation of any of the above conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
The ABLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA Chandra Sekhar Meher vs State Of Odisha .... Opp.
